**Flag 1 — `not_an_issue`**

The flagged sentences are the C1 disclosure itself, not a gap. The text states (a) status — "current client of Brindlecombe Wistow and has been since 2017"; (b) compensation — "not paid or given anything of value"; and the immediately following sentence states (c) the material conflict — "Her son, Daniel Ogunbiyi, is a relationship manager at the firm, which gives her a personal reason to speak favorably of us." All three C1 elements are present, adjacent to the quoted testimonial, in the same post. The flag also cites C9 (benefits vs. risks), which is not the relevant code for a testimonial and does not apply to a disclosure paragraph carrying no performance or benefit claim.

Nor does this flag map to any of the unmatched known issues (p1 C8 selected positions, p2 C4 cherry-picked window, p3 C3 missing 1/5/10-year periods) — all three sit in Posts 1–3 and concern performance presentation, not the Post 4 testimonial.

flags.note: The quoted text is the C1 disclosure, not a gap in it. It states the person is a current client ('current client of Brindlecombe Wistow and has been since 2017'), that no compensation was paid ('not paid or given anything of value'), and the very next sentence discloses the material conflict ('Her son, Daniel Ogunbiyi, is a relationship manager at the firm, which gives her a personal reason to speak favorably of us'). All three C1 elements are present, clear, and placed immediately with the testimonial. The cited code C9 is also inapposite: the passage makes no benefit claim requiring balancing risk language. Does not correspond to p1, p2 or p3, which all concern performance presentation in Posts 1-3.
